title: Fastned - Opel Ampera-e 60 kWh (2017-2021) charge graph
notes: Charge graph embedded in the Fastned vehicle page (Ampera-e 60 kWh (2017 - 2021), charger class 50+), one kW value per SoC %, read with curl. Page carries no reuse terms and the Fastned terms of use have no clause on vehicle chart data (owner confirms). Fastned says curves assume a battery near 30 C.
